name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeCont.run_bind
lines: ⊢ run (FreeM.bind x f) k = x.run fun i => (f i).run k
⊢ run ((pure a).bind f) k = run (pure a) fun i => (f i).run k
ih : ∀ (i : ι✝) (k : β → r), run ((cont i).bind f) k = run (cont i) fun i => (f i).run k
⊢ run (((lift op).bind cont).bind f) k = run ((lift op).bind cont) fun i => (f i).run k
⊢ run ((lift op).bind fun x => (cont x).bind f) k = run ((lift op).bind cont) fun i => (f i).run k
⊢ run ((lift (ContF.callCC a✝)).bind fun x => (cont x).bind f) k =
run ((lift (ContF.callCC a✝)).bind cont) fun i => (f i).run k

steps.tactic:
induction x using FreeM.induction generalizing k with
| pure a => rfl
| lift_bind op cont ih =>
  rw [FreeM.bind_assoc]
  cases op
  simp [← liftBind_eq, run, ih]
